SELECT SUM(NVL(a.total_visits, 0))-SUM(NVL(a.return_visits, 0)) AS totalVisits, --门诊量(总就诊人次-复诊人次) SUM(NVL(a.famous_expert, 0)) AS famousExpert, -- 名医出诊人次 SUM(NVL(a.special_expert, 0)) AS specialExpert, -- 特需专家出诊人次 SUM(NVL(a.known_expert, 0)) AS knownExpert, -- 知名专家出诊人次 SUM(NVL(a.expert_a, 0)) AS expertA, -- 专家A出诊人次 SUM(NVL(a.expert_b, 0)) AS expertB, -- 专家B出诊人次 SUM(NVL(a.ordinary, 0)) AS ordinary, -- 普通门诊出诊人次 SUM(NVL(a.unit_famous_effective, 0)) AS unitFamousEffective, -- 名医有效出诊单元 SUM(NVL(a.unit_famous_total, 0)) AS unitFamousTotal, -- 名医出诊单元总数 SUM(NVL(a.unit_special_effective, 0)) AS unitSpecialEffective, -- 特需有效出诊单元 SUM(NVL(a.unit_special_total, 0)) AS unitSpecialTotal, -- 特需出诊单元总数 SUM(NVL(a.unit_known_effective, 0)) AS unitKnownEffective, -- 知名专家有效出诊单元 SUM(NVL(a.unit_known_total, 0)) AS unitKnownTotal, -- 知名专家出诊单元总数 SUM(NVL(a.unit_a_effective, 0)) AS unitAEffective, -- 专家A有效出诊单元 SUM(NVL(a.unit_a_total, 0)) AS unitATotal, -- 专家A出诊单元总数 SUM(NVL(a.unit_b_effective, 0)) AS unitBEffective, -- 专家B有效出诊单元 SUM(NVL(a.unit_b_total, 0)) AS unitBTotal, -- 专家B出诊单元总数 SUM(NVL(a.unit_ordinary_effective, 0)) AS unitOrdinaryEffective, -- 普通有效出诊单元 SUM(NVL(a.unit_ordinary_total, 0)) AS unitOrdinaryTotal, -- 普通出诊单元总数 SUM(NVL(a.appointment_total, 0)) AS appointmentTotal, -- 预约总数 SUM(NVL(a.appointment_count, 0)) AS appointmentCount, -- 预约数 SUM(NVL(a.self_pay_total, 0)) AS selfPayTotal, -- 自助缴费总数(智慧结算率分母) SUM(NVL(a.self_settle_count, 0)) AS selfSettleCount, -- 自助结算数(智慧结算率分子) SUM(NVL(a.return_visits, 0)) AS returnVisits, -- 复诊人次 SUM(NVL(a.no_window_count, 0)) AS treatCount, -- 非窗口挂号数(预约诊疗率分子=本值-退号量) MAX(a.unit) AS unit, -- 出诊单元 ROUND(AVG(NVL(o.avg_waiting_time_new, 0)), 1) AS efficiency -- 平均等候时长(tr_hrap_opd_overview每日一条,按stat_date左连,无数据计0) FROM TR_OUTP_OP a LEFT JOIN tr_hrap_opd_overview o ON o.stat_date = a.stat_date WHERE a.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND a.dept_code = #{deptCode}
